ai_review.summary: A sublime matrix capture of Winterland ’72 delivering a stellar Mississippi Half Step and an out‑of‑this‑world Dark Star > Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The show is repeatedly praised as one of the finest of 1972, highlighted by a transcendent Dark Star into a powerful Stella Blue and a standout Mississippi Half Step. The matrix recording – a soundboard with audience patches – is described as crystal‑clear, “ballroom” sounding and virtually flawless aside from occasional minor drop‑outs. Overall the performance and audio combine for an exceptionally listenable experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the matrix recording indicate a top‑tier show with excellent audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Many reviewers call the matrix "great", "sublime" and note a crisp, ballroom‑like sound from the board with audience patches; only one mention of minor drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe a perfect setlist with a seamless flow, especially praising the second‑set Dark Star → Stella Blue sequence and the placement of He's Gone in the first set.
